title: edge_frequency_table
description: Computes, for user-specified edges, the proportion of seeds where each algorithm configuration recovered the edge.

ids.description: List of algorithm configuration IDs (columns in the table).

edges.description: List of edges as [node1, node2] pairs. One table is produced per edge.

graph_type.description: Graph type to convert estimates to before computing edge frequency.

annot.description: If true, write the value as text in each cell of the heatmap.

show_title.description: If true, show the title above the heatmap.

show_cbar.description: If true, show the colorbar to the right of the heatmap.

figsize.description: Figure size as [width, height] in inches. If null, matplotlib auto-sizes.

format.description: Output file format for the heatmap.
